workHistory.title: Software Engineer · Runo
workHistory.description: On a sales CRM, I take the problems that cut across the product and make them dependable: rep chats that never reached the CRM, analytics nobody could trust, calling modes an account couldn't combine, and a daily report run that took 42 minutes.

workHistory.title: Mobile Application Developer · NMOLD (OPC) Private Limited
workHistory.description: Part-time during the last three semesters of my B.Tech: rebuilt NMOLD's inventory system and connected its factory machines to it.

workHistory.title: Campus Software Developer · Panipat Institute of Engineering & Technology
workHistory.description: Paid, part-time during my B.Tech. As the college's only developer I built and ran its exam, feedback, ticketing and bus-tracking systems, and kept them running until I graduated.

workHistory.title: Freelance · Automation and AI
workHistory.description: A Python OMR reader that processed more than 90,000 exam sheets, plus Jenkins and Terraform work. Supplier price scraping and margin-based price updates for an OpenCart store. A chatbot over product documentation on AWS Lightsail, and a scraper for NGO details.

workHistory.title: Freelance · Blockchain
workHistory.description: A blockchain donation tracker for an NGO, an OCR answer-sheet checker, and client websites and hosting.

workHistory.title: Freelance · Products for startups
workHistory.description: A job portal and equipment marketplace for the construction industry. A hospital management system, built with a student team. A social platform where students track and share achievements. The frontend website for a milk-delivery startup.

workHistory.title: Freelance · Sites and portals
workHistory.description: An exam module in Laravel for a civil-services coaching institute. A quiz portal for intern certification, and updates to the company website. Upkeep of a legacy CodeIgniter property listing site, and a Node.js information portal. Fixes and improvements to a company website.

workHistory.title: Freelance · Mobile apps
workHistory.description: A Flutter redesign of a prayer app for Ramadan, with audio playback. An Android news app, plus a rentals platform and a classifieds website.

workHistory.title: Freelance · Hosting and operations
workHistory.description: Plesk servers, DNS and security, including honeypots, across a web agency's hosting. Hosting for a news website, including its move to AWS Lightsail. Recovering client sites from backups, then hosting, DNS and email.

projects.title: Blockchain NGO Donation Tracking
projects.tagline: Donors could not see what happened to their money. Now every donation and payout is on a public ledger.
projects.summary: Donors to a nonprofit had no way to check how their money was spent. I built Ethereum smart contracts that put each donation's lifecycle on-chain, with receipt hashes anyone can audit and payout attestations signed in MetaMask, without the platform ever holding donors' keys.

projects.title: Crickiaa
projects.summary: Flutter UI for a gully cricket match management app: OTP-based login, match listing, team creation, and batting/bowling stats screens. Took a Figma-exported scaffold to a working app: OTP auth integration, SVG iconography and a fixed Android build.

projects.title: E-commerce Price & Catalog Sync
projects.tagline: Daily manual price checks replaced by generated OpenCart imports
projects.summary: An electronics store checked supplier prices by hand every day. I automated supplier catalog extraction and price-drift detection, with margin rules and outlier thresholds that produce ready-to-import OpenCart files.

metrics.label: Safety
metrics.value: Large deltas queued for human review

projects.title: floor_plan_builder, a Flutter package
projects.tagline: JSON-driven interactive venue layouts with pinch-zoom and tap callbacks
projects.summary: Flutter package for rendering interactive restaurant/venue floor plans from a JSON table list: shapes, availability colors, pinch-to-zoom, and onTableTap callbacks.

projects.title: image_hotspot, a Flutter package
projects.tagline: Normalized-coordinate hit-testing for clickable regions on images
projects.summary: Published a Flutter package for defining interactive, clickable hotspot areas on images, useful for floor plans, diagrams, and annotated photos.

projects.title: School CMS on Shared Hosting
projects.tagline: Laravel 11 + Filament CMS for a government school on shared hosting
projects.summary: Production school CMS: Laravel 11 and Filament v3 with RBAC, galleries, announcements, webhook auto-deploy, and php-ghost-wall integrity checks on shared hosting.

projects.title: Hopfield Network Visualization
projects.summary: Two Jupyter notebooks exploring Hopfield networks: a basic 2-neuron energy landscape demo and an advanced 5x5 grid showing pattern storage and noisy-input recovery with animation.

projects.title: HTML Content Translator
projects.tagline: Translate visible HTML text without destroying the markup
projects.summary: Python utility that walks an HTML DOM with BeautifulSoup, translates visible text nodes (EN→HI), and leaves tags, attributes, and script/style alone.

projects.title: Laravel Queue Worker on Shared Hosting
projects.tagline: Node.js supervisor that keeps php artisan queue:work alive without systemd
projects.summary: Shared hosting has no Supervisor or systemd, so Laravel's queue worker dies and stays dead. I wrote a Node.js process manager that starts the worker and restarts it whenever it exits, so queued jobs keep running.

projects.title: My Dua App
projects.summary: Flutter redesign of an existing Islamic app. It consumes a live WordPress REST API for dua/dhikr content, schedules device-local adhan alarms per prayer time (geolocation-based), and streams audio via a persistent bottom-nav player.

projects.title: Manufacturing Inventory Platform Rebuild
projects.tagline: A rigid inventory monolith rebuilt as one Flutter app, with live machine data from the factory floor
projects.summary: NMOLD's inventory ran on a rigid legacy stack: new product attributes needed schema migrations, operators typed counts by hand, and machine data never left the factory network. I led the rebuild in Flutter, Express and MongoDB and bridged the plant's PLCs into it. Live at one site.

metrics.label: Telemetry
metrics.value: OPC UA via Node-RED into Express

projects.title: No-Code ML Environment
projects.tagline: Upload a CSV, pick a target column, train a model: no notebook required
projects.summary: Flask app that wraps common supervised-learning pipelines behind a UI: CSV upload, column picker, sklearn regressors or Keras LSTM, then MAE/MSE/RMSE plus a prediction plot.

projects.title: OMR Sheet Automation
projects.tagline: Staged Python optical-mark pipeline that processed 90,000+ exam sheets
projects.summary: Exam answer sheets were checked by hand, and simple scanners broke on skewed or smudged scans. I built a staged Python and OpenCV pipeline that reads them and resumes from failures instead of rerunning. It has processed more than 90,000 sheets and is still in use.

metrics.label: Status
metrics.value: Still in production use at the org today

projects.title: PHP Ghost Wall
projects.tagline: Laravel boot-time SHA-256 file integrity check and server phone-home for shared hosting
projects.summary: On shared hosting nothing notices when a deployed file is quietly changed. I published a Composer package that hash-checks a monitored file on every Laravel boot and sends a tamper alert, with server details, the moment it differs.

projects.title: PIET Quest Exam Portal
projects.tagline: Students sitting side by side got different papers, so copying stopped paying off
projects.summary: Campus exams ran side by side in shared labs, where one screen was easy to copy from. I built PIET Quest, the college's exam portal: each student gets their own question and option order, leaving the exam window is detected, and faculty load whole question banks in bulk.

projects.title: RAG Document Chatbot
projects.tagline: Grounding an LLM in a document set with LlamaIndex
projects.summary: Retrieval-augmented chatbot over PDF docs: embed with a hosted model, retrieve top chunks, answer with an LLM constrained to that context. Flask UI, and a clear path from one shared index to per-user indexes.

projects.title: Real-time Location Tracker
projects.tagline: Socket.IO + Leaflet: live GPS markers that appear, move, and vanish on disconnect
projects.summary: Browser GPS sharing over Socket.IO: every connected client broadcasts coordinates; a shared Leaflet map shows live markers with device popups and auto-fit bounds.

projects.title: Admin App Imports and Integrations
projects.tagline: One checked import flow and one integration setup, in place of a one-off screen per page
projects.summary: Ops ran bulk imports and CRM integrations through admin pages that each parsed, validated and reported errors their own way, and a stray click could lose a half-finished mapping. I moved them onto one shared import and integration flow, module by module, while ops kept working. Seven connectors run on it today.

metrics.label: Integrations on it
metrics.value: 7: Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot, Facebook Lead Ads, WhatsApp Business, S3, GCS

projects.title: Hybrid Telephony Workflows
projects.tagline: Accounts were locked into SIM or cloud calling; now they run both at once
projects.summary: Runo already supported SIM-based call tracking and Airtel IQ cloud telephony, but never together; an account got one or the other. I unified both into one account-level capability, usable at the same time in the same app.

metrics.label: Before
metrics.value: SIM tracking and cloud (Airtel IQ): one or the other, per account

metrics.label: After
metrics.value: Both simultaneously, one account, one session

metrics.label: Attribution
metrics.value: callMedium threaded through activity and reports

timeline.title: Exclusivity audit
timeline.description: Confirmed SIM tracking and cloud (Airtel IQ) telephony were mutually exclusive per account: switching or adding a virtual number meant reconfiguring the account, not a toggle.

timeline.title: Unified state model
timeline.description: Replaced the either-or account flag with a single SIM / Cloud / Hybrid enum so both paths can be active on one account.

timeline.title: In-app selector and attribution
timeline.description: Shipped CallMediumSelector and threaded callMedium through logs and analytics so reporting reflects which path an actual call used.

projects.title: Product Analytics Pipeline
projects.tagline: Analytics the team can trust: test data kept out, duplicates dropped, offline activity delivered once the connection returns
projects.summary: Tracking calls were scattered through Flutter screens, so staging events polluted production dashboards, re-renders fired duplicates and offline activity was dropped. I built one typed analytics layer over Amplitude that fixes all three. It carries ~15M events a month and has reprocessed 45M in one run.

metrics.label: Largest run
metrics.value: 45M events in one full reprocess (3-month window)

timeline.title: Telemetry audit
timeline.description: Mapped scattered tracking calls lacking shared schema validation, environment isolation, and retry behavior.

timeline.title: ProductAnalytics facade
timeline.description: Introduced AnalyticsProvider contract and typed user/account identity models.

timeline.title: Buffering and dedup rollout
timeline.description: Shipped Hive-backed event buffering and sliding-window deduplication middleware.

projects.title: WhatsApp Web CRM Sidecar
projects.tagline: Capturing WhatsApp Web conversations into a CRM with no official API
projects.summary: Sales reps' WhatsApp Web conversations never reached the CRM, and WhatsApp has no API for it. I built a Manifest V3 Chrome extension that finds WhatsApp's internal stores at runtime, syncs chats and call history in the background, and never changes the chat a rep is looking at.

metrics.label: Official API used
metrics.value: None: WhatsApp Business API does not cover reading a live personal Web session

metrics.label: Store discovery
metrics.value: Named module lookup first, structural matching as fallback

metrics.label: UI impact during sync
metrics.value: None: active chat verified unchanged across a full history page

timeline.title: Runtime store discovery
timeline.description: Located WhatsApp Web's Chat/Msg/Contact/Conn stores inside a minified webpack bundle by structural shape matching.

timeline.title: Two-tier rewrite
timeline.description: Switched to exact module-id lookup after a structural-typing false positive, keeping shape matching as a degradation path.

timeline.title: Background catch-up
timeline.description: Replaced UI-driven chat switching with direct history paging against the store.

projects.title: Schema-Driven School CRUD GUI
projects.tagline: Add a SQLite table: get navigation, forms, and grids for free
projects.summary: A desktop GUI that introspects a SQLite schema at runtime and generates navigation, CRUD forms and tables from it: a compact low-code engine instead of hand-built screens.

projects.title: Smart Irrigation IoT
projects.tagline: NodeMCU sensor telemetry, Firebase fan-out, and an SVM actuation model with edge fail-safes
projects.summary: Built a soil/climate irrigation setup: NodeMCU sensors publish to Firebase, a Flutter dashboard visualizes the stream, and an SVM model drives pump actuation with hard edge cutoffs if the cloud path stalls.

caseStudies.title: Flutter web admin migration with no downtime
caseStudies.tagline: Every admin page parsed uploads its own way, and one stray click could wipe a half-built mapping. I moved them onto one checked import flow, module by module, without taking the tools offline.
caseStudies.summary: Every admin page had its own upload, validation and error handling, and closing a dialog could wipe a half-finished mapping. I replaced them with one import flow that checks files in the browser and protects unsaved work, moved over while ops kept using the tools.

metrics.label: Integrations on the shared flow
metrics.value: 7: Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot, Facebook Lead Ads, WhatsApp Business, S3, GCS

metrics.label: Scheduled downtime
metrics.value: None: modules moved over one at a time

caseStudies.title: SIM and cloud calling in one account
caseStudies.tagline: Accounts had to choose SIM tracking or cloud calling. I removed the either-or, so both run in one session and every call records which path it used.
caseStudies.summary: Runo's app had SIM call tracking and Airtel IQ cloud calling, but an account could only use one, and switching meant reconfiguring it. I replaced the either-or flag so both run live in one session, and every call records the path it used.

metrics.label: Before
metrics.value: SIM tracking or cloud (Airtel IQ), never both, per account

metrics.label: After
metrics.value: Both simultaneously, one account, one session

caseStudies.title: Factory PLC data on a remote dashboard
caseStudies.tagline: Checking a machine meant walking the factory floor. I built a bridge off the isolated PLC network, so a manager now sees and switches machines from anywhere.
caseStudies.summary: Siemens and Delta PLC data never left an isolated factory network. I hand-built an ESP bridge to get it out, put Node-RED and OPC UA on top, and gave the plant a secured remote dashboard that reads machine status and switches equipment.

metrics.label: Remote access
metrics.value: Secured tunnel to a live dashboard

caseStudies.title: Analytics events the team can trust
caseStudies.tagline: Test data leaked into production dashboards, re-renders fired duplicates and offline activity was dropped. One typed layer over Amplitude fixed all three.
caseStudies.summary: Analytics calls were scattered through the Flutter screens, so test data reached production dashboards, duplicates skewed funnels and offline activity was lost. I replaced them with one typed layer over Amplitude that now carries ~15M events a month.

caseStudies.title: WhatsApp Web chats into a CRM, without an API
caseStudies.tagline: Reps' WhatsApp conversations never reached the CRM, and WhatsApp has no API for it. This extension syncs them in the background without touching the chat the rep has open.
caseStudies.summary: Sales reps work leads in WhatsApp Web, and WhatsApp offers no API to get those chats into a CRM. I built a Chrome extension that reads WhatsApp Web's internal stores, syncs chats in the background without disturbing the rep, and stops rather than guesses when WhatsApp changes underneath it.

metrics.label: Official API available
metrics.value: None: it reads WhatsApp Web's own internal stores

metrics.label: Rep's screen during sync
metrics.value: Unchanged, verified across a full history page
